recommendation: Ready for external mathematical review as a focused research note; no journal-acceptance prediction.
scoring_scale: 0 to 10; qualitative self-assessment, not acceptance probabilities

scores.rationale: Own seed and recurrence claims survive the audit; the imported analytic upper theorem remains essential.
Focused pinned-source comparison supports a contribution candidate; global priority is unestablished.
Strict separation from an entire construction class; the unrestricted optimum remains far away.
Inherited geometry, operation rules, recursion, tail method and upper theorem are explicitly credited.
Exact independent algorithms, immutable delivery checks, negative controls and cross-platform replay.
Scope, rationality, affine equivalence and the two all-dimensional recipes are clarified.
All eight pages inspected; consistent theorem/table/reference style and no LaTeX layout warnings.
Complete research draft and reproduction snapshot; external review and a public archival deposit remain outstanding.

findings.finding: The delivery checker accepted an empty or incomplete manifest.
findings.fix: Require coverage of core proof artifacts, valid SHA-256 entries, unique safe paths and exact file hashes.
findings.evidence: Tests reject empty, partial and duplicate manifests; the sealed package is replayed after extraction.

findings.finding: The main runner regenerated evidence in place, so a failed check could replace delivered evidence.
findings.fix: Regenerate certificates and reports in a temporary directory and compare their bytes to delivered files.
findings.evidence: Before/after file hashes are compared during Windows and Linux replay.

findings.finding: Some altered-constant controls only established rejection of unexpected field values.
findings.fix: Accept positive claimed constants and check their actual inequalities; reject mathematically false endpoints, padding and thresholds.
findings.evidence: Nine unit tests run in normal and optimized Python; four growth self-controls reject false mathematics.

findings.finding: The earlier sufficient threshold 20000 used avoidably coarse finite comparison constants.
findings.fix: Certify block root 2.8581, class root 2.8548, prefactor 1.051 and all 197 residue bounds with padding 1/3500.
findings.evidence: Exact comparison at n=15500 and a proved monotone ratio give all larger dimensions; sharpness is not claimed.

findings.finding: The dimension-197 block was specified recursively but lacked a delivered flattened inequality description.
findings.fix: Supply 224 sparse integer facet inequalities and check them against an independently flattened mass-coordinate construction.
findings.evidence: Exact row-multiset agreement and a strict interior probe; 46,118,408 vertices are counted, not enumerated.

findings.finding: Rationality, affine-map scope and fixed-dimension seed ranking needed more precise qualifications.
findings.fix: Require rational tilts for rational bodies, m>=1, invertible affine equivalences and fixed dimension/recursion for ranking.
findings.evidence: Definitions, seed proof, ranking proposition, README and contribution ledger agree.

findings.finding: The class separation could be mistaken for proximity to unrestricted optimality.
findings.fix: Add the classical unrestricted upper bound and its limiting root pi*e/2; distinguish inherited methods from the new specialized seeds.
findings.evidence: Versioned Saroglou primary preprint and pinned calculus/upper-theorem sources are cited; priority remains unasserted.

findings.finding: The seed-volume change of variables and facet-existence argument were too compressed.
findings.fix: State the Jacobian and transformed coefficient differences, explain all facets, and consistently typeset proofs and exact endpoints.
findings.evidence: Eight-page final render inspected page by page; no clipping, overlaps or unresolved references.

unresolved_limits: This report is an internal adversarial AI-assisted self-review, not independent external peer review.

The whole-class separation uses an essential attributed, unreviewed mixed Bellman upper theorem. Its finite exact obligations were replayed; neither its analytic proof nor this paper is proof-assistant formalized.
The focused literature screen does not establish bibliographic priority or exclude recent, unpublished or unindexed work.
Neither seed, recursive schedule, limiting constant nor sufficient threshold 15500 is claimed optimal.
The dimension-197 inequalities are checked for equivalence to the recursive block; its volume is obtained by inherited operation identities, not an independent high-dimensional volume computation.
The known simplex-bound questions in dimensions four through eight remain open.
The research package is locally committed; this review does not establish a public GitHub/DOI archival deposit.
